import ralph


def test_count_incomplete_tasks_counts_only_unchecked() -> None:
    tasks = "\n".join(
        [
            "# tasks",
            "- [ ] write tokenizer — implement bpe merges",
            "- [x] set up repo — done already",
            "* [ ] add tests — cover round trip",
            "  - [ ] nested task — indented checkbox",
            "- [X] capital x checked — should not count",
        ]
    )
    assert ralph.count_incomplete_tasks(tasks) == 3


def test_count_incomplete_tasks_empty_and_complete() -> None:
    assert ralph.count_incomplete_tasks("") == 0
    assert ralph.count_incomplete_tasks("- [x] everything done") == 0


def test_output_signals_done_detects_sentinel() -> None:
    assert ralph.output_signals_done("all finished. RALPH_DONE") is True
    assert ralph.output_signals_done("still working on task three") is False


def test_looks_rate_limited_matches_common_phrasings() -> None:
    assert ralph.looks_rate_limited("Error: 429 Too Many Requests") is True
    assert ralph.looks_rate_limited("you are rate-limited, retry later") is True
    assert ralph.looks_rate_limited("quota exceeded for model") is True
    assert ralph.looks_rate_limited("task completed successfully") is False


def test_prompts_contain_goal_and_contract() -> None:
    goal = "verify tests work"
    plan_prompt = ralph.build_plan_prompt(goal)
    loop_prompt = ralph.build_loop_prompt(goal)
    assert goal in plan_prompt
    assert "ralph/tasks.md" in plan_prompt
    assert "- [ ]" in plan_prompt
    assert goal in loop_prompt
    assert "exactly one unchecked task" in loop_prompt
    assert ralph.DONE_SENTINEL in loop_prompt


def test_model_is_deepseek_v4_flash_on_opencode() -> None:
    assert ralph.OPENCODE_MODEL == "opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free"
